issues.description: Missing `import sys` in numba/cpython/mathimpl.py and numba/np/math/mathimpl.py
issues.detail: The patch references `sys.version_info` in both mathimpl files but only adds `import sys` to typing/mathdecl.py. If `sys` isn't already imported in those two modules, the code will NameError at import time on Python 3.11+. Show me the code — verify the imports exist or add them. This is the kind of thing that should have been caught by actually running the build.

issues.description: Registration of math.exp2 in mathdecl.py is placed outside the class with broken formatting
issues.detail: The `if sys.version_info >= (3, 11): Math_unary = infer_global(math.exp2)(Math_unary)` block is jammed against the class definition, eats the blank line separating it from `Math_atan2`, and reassigns `Math_unary` as a side effect. This is ugly. Put the version guard inline at the top of the file or use a clean registration block with proper spacing. Match the surrounding voice of the file.

issues.description: Release note file missing trailing newline
issues.detail: `docs/upcoming_changes/10276.new_feature.rst` ends with `\ No newline at end of file`. Trivial fixup, but it's the kind of thing a maintainer shouldn't have to fix for you. Add the newline.

issues.description: Test reuses copy-pasted x_values with duplicates and lacks exp2-specific edge cases
issues.detail: `x_values = [-2, -1, -2, 2, 1, 2, .1, .2]` is copy-pasted from `test_exp` and contains duplicate `-2` and `2`. For exp2 specifically, integer powers (0, 1, 10) would give exact known answers (1, 2, 1024) and make failures obvious. Not a blocker, but the test could be doing real work instead of mirroring the neighbor.

issues.description: Unused `exp2_impl` binding pattern matches existing style but assigns to a name nothing reads
issues.detail: `exp2_impl = unary_math_intr(math.exp2, 'llvm.exp2')` follows the existing convention (`exp_impl = ...`), so this is consistent — but worth noting the assignment is decorative; the registration happens as a side effect of the call. Fine as-is because it matches surrounding code. Don't change it just for me.

review.summary: Three-line feature patch that mostly does the right thing — small, scoped, matches the surrounding registration pattern for unary math intrinsics, and ships docs + tests. But it ships with at least one likely build-break (sys not imported in the mathimpl files where sys.version_info is referenced), formatting that swallows a blank line in mathdecl.py, and a release note missing its trailing newline. Fix the imports, clean up the version-guard placement, add the newline, and this lands. Verdict: NEEDS-WORK. Author is new to numba — feedback is on the code, not on them.
